title: Wonderful Experience
text: This experience was one of the highlights of my time in Sevilla.  The chef was personable and shared so many interesting stories and tips for making Paella.  The event space worked well for the demonstration and the rooftop dining allowed for a beautiful view of the city.  The food and drinks were exquisite!

title: Paella tour
text: Our chef Maria was very knowledgeable in Spanish cuisine. She shared tips for cooking the paella. The wines presented for the tasting were fabulous. A true great selection. The rooftop dinner was fantastic.
author: Lucy_R

title: A must do
text: Me and my boyfriend absolutely loved! Definitely one of our favourite things we did while in Seville. Couldn’t recommend enough
author: rinoad2025

title: Best Paella Show Cooking!!
text:
We went to the Seville La Terraza del Cristina Paella Showcooking with my wife and had the best time! The paella was absolutely amazing, and the sangria was just as good. The views from the rooftop were also incredible and made the whole experience even more special.
Our host, Eyrian, was the highlight of the experience. She was so much fun, incredibly friendly, and did a fantastic job explaining the whole paella-making process.
It was also a really intimate experience, as there was only one other person with us. We all got along so well and had lots of fun together, which made the experience
author: liammR1607DP

title: Paella cooking demonstration
text:
We had a fantastic time at this experience and would highly recommend it to anyone visiting the area.

We were greeted right on time at the meeting point by the chef, who made us feel very welcome. We were then shown to a cosy kitchen workstation, where a selection of olives, cheeses, and cured meats was waiting for us to enjoy while we watched the demonstration.

author: Ann_M

title: Dig into some paella!
